name: ci-watch
description: Watches the CI of your pull requests and starts a turn when a PR turns red, conflicts or is green to merge, so no agent sleep-polls CI. With loop=on (the default) it runs the lane loop: at most 3 fix tries per PR, merge on green under merge-policy, a watch of the deploy run of the merge commit, a staging verify turn, then one close-and-cleanup turn; at most 60 automatic turns a day, and no turn while ~/.claude/autonomy.off exists. fix_turns=off keeps the notifications and starts no turn for red CI and conflicts. With autoMerge=true (the default) it merges your own PRs by itself at green: only when the kill switch is off, the PR is yours and not a draft, CI is green and mergeStateStatus is CLEAN, no changes are requested, it is no production release and ~/.claude/merge-policy.json allows the merge; else a toast and the status line say why it holds. Other mods and the model add a PR through the tool mcp__ci-watch__watch.

fix_turns.title: Fix turns
fix_turns.description: on: a red or conflicted PR starts a turn that fixes it. off: it only gets a toast and a notification; use off when another watcher (the desktop app Auto-fix) does the fix. The green path is the same for the two values.

loop.title: Lane loop
loop.description: on: the lane loop (fix tries counted to 3, decision records, merge under merge-policy, deploy watch, verify, close and cleanup turns, a cap of 60 automatic turns a day). off: ci-watch acts as in 0.2 (the kill switch file still stops every turn).

autoMerge.title: Auto-merge your PRs
autoMerge.description: true: when CI turns green, ci-watch starts the merge turn (merge-when-green steps: squash when the rule allows it, delete the branch) for your own PRs, only when every rule holds: kill switch off, your PR, not a draft, CI green, mergeStateStatus CLEAN, no requested changes, no production release, and merge-policy allows it. Else it holds and says why. false: only PRs with auto-merge asked for on them (/ci-watch auto-merge <pr> on).

autoMergeSkip.title: Repos with no auto-merge
autoMergeSkip.description: Empty (the default): the option autoMerge applies to every repo. A list of repos, with commas or spaces between them (owner/name, or owner/* for every repo of an owner): ci-watch does not merge the PRs of these repos by itself. A PR with auto-merge asked for on it (/ci-watch auto-merge <pr> on) still merges.
